verdict.rationale: Once a user connects accounts, Bench runs fixed background automations: transaction data flows in on its own, transactions are categorized automatically, categorization rules are generated from past patterns, and merchant fees are reconciled automatically. These are pre-built, vendor-defined bookkeeping pipelines rather than automations the user designs or schedules, and the work also relies on a human bookkeeping team. Missing for 10: user-defined automation rules, triggers or workflows; recurring schedules the user configures; agent-style autonomous task execution; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
